Container.Name: roadtrip-games
Container.Overview: Score Flocks, Zombie Flocks, Volvo trucks and the license plate game on an iPad in the car, with lifetime stats, awards and a map of every trip. The iPad saves everything itself and syncs to this server whenever it can reach home. Open the plain address once on the iPad and follow "Turn on locations for the map" under Trips and players to use the secure address.

Config.Name: Web page
Config.Description: The plain address. Open this first on the iPad.

Config.Name: Secure web page (GPS)
Config.Description: The secure (https) address. The iPad only shares its location with this one.

Config.Name: Game history
Config.Description: Where every trip is kept, plus the certificate the iPad trusts. Back this folder up.

Config.Name: Server address for the iPad
Config.Description: The address the iPad uses to reach this Unraid server, for example 192.168.1.10. Add more separated by commas (tower.local, or a WireGuard address).

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Used for the times in the log.
